text: Guys, one of the biggest mistakes you can make with women is waiting too long. Here's the scenario. A guy likes a girl, but instead of acting, he drags it out. He procrastinates. He waits for more signals that she likes him back. So what does he do? He keeps texting her for months, liking her stories, checking if she likes his story back. Guys, this is a huge mistake. First, women don't like indecisive men. If you drag it out too long, she won't think you're being careful. She will think you're slow. Or worse, she'll just put you in a friend zone. Second, while you're wasting time, some other guy can step in, be more proactive, and get her attention. And then what? You're left empty-handed, regretting you never even tried. One more time. Simplify, don't complicate. You like a girl, but you're not sure if she likes you back? Stop overthinking. Just ask her out. Her response will tell you everything. If she says yes, perfect, you move forward, you build momentum. If she says no, fine, that is your answer. Respect yourself, respect your time, and move on. Because here's the reality. Spending months texting, waiting, hoping only to end up with nothing? That's the real waste. Act sooner, don't drag your feet. Either she's in, or she's not. And either way, you win. Because you didn't waste your time.
